name: List a game's seasons
description: Layer 06 §6.7: every season of the game, newest first, each with its derived state -- closed, scheduled, open or settling -- its window, its engine and its rules. The index of past seasons, whose standings are read by GET /v1/games/{game}/leaderboard?season=N and are kept for ever (rule 5).

input.query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(season_json(s) ORDER BY s.number DESC), '[]'::json) AS body FROM seasons s JOIN games g ON g.id = s.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text
